# Wardogs — Settings and Input Actions
*Extracted from cooked game data. Values are as exported; nothing here was checked in-game. Tables are generated by `_tools/settings_tables.py` from the JSON, so they are reproducible.*

This page lists the user-setting assets (the options-menu rows) and every input action asset, with their default key bindings where a mapping context assigns one. Where an export omits a numeric default or a discrete index, the table says "omitted" and does not resolve the native class default. Input value types and key bindings are as exported; the runtime behaviour of each action is not traced here.

---
